description: Source code implementing USB device class management functions for Zephyr OS, including class registration, retrieval, and removal.

methods.name: usbd_class_desc_len
methods.description: Calculates the total length of descriptors associated with a USB device class node.

methods.name: usbd_class_get_by_config
methods.description: Retrieves a class node matching a specific configuration and interface number.

methods.name: usbd_class_get_by_iface
methods.description: Retrieves a class node based on interface number in current configuration.

methods.name: usbd_class_handle_xfer
methods.description: Handles a transfer request for a USB class, invoking class-specific request processing.

methods.name: usbd_class_get_by_ep
methods.description: Retrieves a class node associated with a specific endpoint.

methods.name: usbd_class_get_by_req
methods.description: Finds a class node that supports a specific request.

methods.name: usbd_register_class
methods.description: Registers a USB class with the device context, making it active.

methods.name: usbd_unregister_class
methods.description: Unregisters a USB class from the device context.

methods.name: usbd_class_node_get
methods.description: Finds a class node by name from the section of registered classes.

methods.name: usbd_class_append
methods.description: Appends a class node to a specific device configuration.

methods.name: usbd_class_remove
methods.description: Removes a class node from a specific device configuration.

methods.name: usbd_class_remove_all
methods.description: Removes all class nodes from a specific device configuration.
